title: Exact additive extension by zero adjoint to localized restriction with independent coefficient universe
statement: For a sheaf of rings R on a Grothendieck site and an object U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], assuming the localized restriction functor preserves zero morphisms, there is a functor G from localized R-module sheaves to R-module sheaves preserving finite limits and finite colimits, together with an adjunction G ⊣ restriction, and the localized restriction functor is additive. This universe-general form takes C : Type u with Category v and coefficient/module universe max u v r, for arbitrary r; assume abelian-group sheafification and its locally bijective characterization on the original site. It uses the same sheaves, restriction, Hom complex, differentials, and induced maps as the original source statement.

proof.text: Work with objects in Type u, arrows in Type v, and coefficient rings and modules in Type (max u v r). Use the existing siteAbelianHasSheafify and siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective instances on the slice whenever an abelian or exactness instance is needed. All these instances are proved, and the given base-site instances are retained.

Obtain the exact left adjoint and its finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation from localized_restriction_extension_exists. Prove additivity of restriction sectionwise by extensionality on sections.
